outcome: Diagnosis and surveillance of monochorionic gestations
Management of TTTS (e.g., fetoscopic laser surgery, expectant management)
cohort: Monochorionic twin pregnancies, specifically those complicated by twin-twin transfusion syndrome or twin anemia-polycythemia sequence.
finding: The document provides 14 graded recommendations for the comprehensive diagnosis, surveillance, and management of twin-twin transfusion syndrome and twin anemia-polycythemia sequence in monochorionic twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Fetoscopic laser surgery is recommended not to influence the mode of delivery.
gest_age: The study focuses on monochorionic twin pregnancies, with recommendations for surveillance from 16 weeks gestation and delivery timings ranging from 32 to 39 weeks gestation depending on the specific complication and outcome.
